summary_markdown:
A fix for charts granulated by week or month was deployed to the staging environment. The recipient was asked to verify the time axis behavior for periods exceeding 180 days and 1 year, ensuring that the axis correctly starts and ends at the beginning/end of the respective week or month.

A follow-up step involves deploying the analytics changes after verification and informing Ocean.
decisions: The chart fix is deployed to staging.
action_items: Verify time axis behavior for long periods (over 180 days/1 year) on staging charts.
Deploy analytics changes after successful verification.
